comparison_note: The run did not perform an all-vs-all scientific pairwise comparison of 290 images. It GPU-audited 290 unique images and repeatedly sampled from them for self-supervised optimization.

findings.title: Complete CUDA image audit
findings.detail: All 290 unique research images were processed by the GPU audit; unreadable_count was 0.

findings.title: Stable one-hour optimization
findings.detail: The run completed 29,013 steps over 3,600.063 seconds and reduced loss from 0.337373 to 0.072435; best observed loss was 0.037302.

findings.title: Broader project corpus than Training #1
findings.detail: Training #2 used 290 unique images versus 66 source images in Training #1, a 4.39x larger source corpus.

findings.title: Generalization still required independent validation
findings.detail: 696,312 optimization samples were generated from 290 unique images, so repeated sampling remained substantial and held-out scene validation was still required.

findings.title: Environmental change magnitude not established
findings.detail: The run did not persist deterministic scene-pair water, shoreline, glacier, snow or vegetation change measurements, so site-level environmental change values cannot be claimed from this run alone.
